title: Laash akbar ki jo
body:
laash akbar ki jo maqtal se utha laaye hussain
par lahoo seene ka maa se na chupa paaye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
yun sajega tera sehra yun lagegi mehndi
ran se kya haaton pe akbar ki racha laaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi ghurbat ki ghadi noore nazar bhi na raha
bekasi roti hai keh keh ke tujhe haye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa phupi roti hai laashe pe ali akbar ke
kaun hai mere siwa unko jo samjhaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
haye peeri may jawan laal tadapta dekha
apne yusuf ko kyun is dasht may le aaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
laal zainab ne kiye sadqe ali akbar ke
maut akbar ki talay aur na gham khaaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya kahe qaside sughra se ke akbar na rahe
bekhabar bete ko kya soch ke ghabraye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap zinda rahe beta ho jahan se ruqsat
haif jeene may kahan haye na mar jaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shauq e ziarat may ye jeete hai hassan aur ahasan
rashq kismat jo hamay rauze pe bulwaye hussain
laash akbar ki jo...
author: Hassan Abbas Rizvi
